faqs: What is a crypto press release?

A crypto press release is a short news-style article that announces something important about your Web3 or blockchain project. It is published across trusted crypto media sites to increase visibility and credibility.
How does MediaX work?

Choose a plan, submit your press release or let us write it for you, and we will distribute it through our crypto PR distribution network. After it is live, we will send you a report with all placements and metrics.
Where will my press release be published?
Depending on your package, it will appear on sites like Coin Edition, NewsBTC, The Block, Yahoo Finance, and multiple others. View our media list.
How much does a crypto press release cost?
Our Lite plan starts at $600. All plans include guaranteed placements. You can also request a custom quote.
When will my press release go live?
Our releases go live within 24 to 48 hours after approval. Express publishing is available if it is required on an expedited basis.
Do you guarantee media placements?
Yes. All packages include guaranteed crypto press release distribution. We only work with verified media outlets.
Can I choose specific media outlets?
Yes. You can select from our outlet list or let us recommend the best ones based on your goals including DeFi, NFT, AI, and more.
Do you support global distribution?
Yes. We offer international crypto press release distribution across the USA, UAE, UK, Southeast Asia, and Europe.
Can you write or edit my press release?
Yes. Writing and editing services are included in selected plans or available as add-ons. All content is optimized for crypto and blockchain media.
How can I track performance?
After your press release goes live, you will receive a performance report showing all media placements, traffic data, and live URLs.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Learn how MediaX helps blockchain, DeFi, and Web3 projects grow through strategic crypto PR, media relations, and press release distribution.
about.body:
We believe in a data-driven approach when it comes to [PR services](https://mediax.agency/submit-press-release). Our team at [MediaX](https://mediax.agency/) is dedicated to research and analysis to identify growing trends in the media world. With effective thought leadership, we help our clients maximize both the quality and quantity of media coverage.

For your PR success, we use science and art equally, and we never forget to measure your impact, which leads to long-term business growth. MediaX combines genuine insights with the art of storytelling to drive your success.

### Why Choose Us

We are an agency that drives strategic communication. Our team of experts combines insights and analysis to directly benefit your business objectives. MediaX helps you strategize, customize, and deliver your brand communication in a unique and effective way.

We create engaging solutions using modern PR techniques and best practices. Our team brings years of experience in digital marketing, public relations, and brand strategy to build proactive communication plans. These efforts not only set you apart from competitors but also help expand your market reach and revenue.

Whether you're ready to [submit a press release](https://mediax.agency/submit-press-release), explore our [latest insights](https://mediax.agency/blogs), or [contact us](https://mediax.agency/contact), we're here to help your story stand out.

### Our Beliefs

"Our job is to make change. Our job is to connect to people, to interact with them in a way that leaves them better than we found them." – Seth Godin

This belief shapes everything we do. We use PR to connect, elevate, and create meaningful impact in every client interaction.

### Specialization

MediaX focuses on Web3, fintech, sports, and tech startups. This specialization allows us to develop deep industry expertise, build strong media relationships, and understand the unique challenges faced by innovative companies.

### Industry Insights

By concentrating on these sectors, we stay updated with the latest trends in blockchain PR, technology, and media innovation. This enables us to provide clients with timely insights and impactful strategies. Learn more in our [Web3 PR blog](https://mediax.agency/blogs/crypto-blockchain).

### Tailored Approach

Our industry focus allows us to customize PR and media placement services to meet the unique needs of each startup, ensuring campaigns deliver maximum visibility and real results.

### Network and Relationships

Over time, MediaX has built trusted relationships with leading media outlets, journalists, influencers, and industry stakeholders. This ensures our clients get exposure to the right audience at the right time.

### Track Record of Success

We proudly showcase a proven track record of successful PR and media placement campaigns for startups across our core industries. Our work instills confidence and reflects our ability to deliver real results.

### Innovative Approach

Startups in Web3, fintech, sports, and tech demand creative, modern PR strategies. MediaX stays ahead by continuously adopting new technologies and emerging communication trends to help you stay relevant. Read our [Ultimate Guide to Influencer Marketing](https://mediax.agency/blogs/the-ultimate-guide-to-influencer-marketing-for-your-brand) for more.

### Integrated Services

MediaX offers a full spectrum of services including media relations, content creation, social media management, and event planning. Our integrated approach gives clients a complete PR solution.

### Thought Leadership

We position ourselves as thought leaders by regularly publishing insights, industry reports, and expert commentary. Visit our [blog](https://mediax.agency/blogs) or read our [terms](https://mediax.agency/terms-condition) and [privacy policy](https://mediax.agency/privacy) to learn more about how we work.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
## 1. INTRODUCTION
Your privacy is important to us. MediaX Agency ("we", "our", or "us") operates an automated service for PR agencies and businesses to upload and distribute press releases. This Privacy Policy outlines how, when, and why we collect and process your personal information ("Personal Information").

Personal Information refers to any data that can be used to identify, contact, or locate an individual. This may include but is not limited to name, ID, passport number, address, email, credit/debit card details, and other financial data. Any information that does not identify an individual, such as aggregated data, is considered "Anonymous Information," which we may use freely without prior notice.

## 2. CONSENT, NOTIFICATION, AND MODIFICATION
This Privacy Policy governs information collected both for our own use and as a data processor on behalf of clients. By using this Website, you consent to our collection and processing of your Personal Information to manage your account and enhance our services. We may share such data with third parties essential to service execution.

You also agree to provide appropriate notice and obtain necessary permissions from any third parties whose Personal Information is collected, received, or processed through our services.

Personal Information is stored securely for compliance with legal and regulatory obligations. You have the right to access, correct, or object to the processing of your data, including opting out of email communications.

We reserve the right to modify this Privacy Policy in accordance with applicable law. Any changes will take effect within 15 days of posting on the Website, and continued use of our services signifies your acceptance.

## 3. COOKIES
Our Website may use "cookies" and tracking technologies to collect Anonymous Information. A "cookie" is a small text file that helps improve user experience, including storing login credentials.

To review our Cookies Policy, click [here].

## 4. GOOGLE SERVICES
Our services utilize Google APIs to store and share press releases via Google Drive with partners, clients, and publishers. We adhere to Google's API Services User Data Policy, including Limited Use requirements.

## 5. USE AND DISCLOSURE OF PERSONAL INFORMATION
We store and use your Personal Information for:

Managing service administration, providing support, and handling inquiries;
Enforcing our Terms and Conditions and complying with legal requirements;
Preventing service misuse and assisting law enforcement agencies;
Improving our services and developing new features.
We do not sell, lease, or disclose Personal Information to third parties except as required by law. We may share data with law enforcement agencies, credit bureaus, or necessary third-party service providers bound by similar privacy obligations.

If you choose to engage with third-party services via our platform, their respective privacy policies will apply, and we are not responsible for their data practices.

## 6. SECURITY MEASURES
We implement reasonable physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards to protect your Personal Information from unauthorized access, loss, or misuse. However, no security measures are 100% foolproof. While we strive to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security against potential breaches.

## 7. CHANGES TO THIS PRIVACY POLICY
This Privacy Policy may be updated periodically in compliance with applicable laws, including the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The latest version will always be posted on our Website. If material changes occur, we may notify you via email.

This content is provided by sponsor. The statements, views and opinions expressed in this column are solely those of the content provider. The information provided in this press release is not a solicitation for investment, nor is it intended as investment advice, financial advice, or trading advice. It is strongly recommended you practice due diligence, including consultation with a professional financial advisor, before investing in or trading cryptocurrency and securities. Please conduct your own research and invest at your own risk.

## 8. COMPLAINTS & CONTACT INFORMATION
If you believe we have not processed your data in accordance with this policy, please contact us at contact@mediax.agency. We will address your concerns promptly.

By using our Website and services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to this Privacy Policy.
